envelope.description: Add the private deploy-step run state + state-store

body.title: Add the private deploy-step run state + state-store
body.summary: Create src/mcp/deploy-step/state.ts (DeployStepStage) and src/mcp/deploy-step/state-store.ts (private per-run record behind the opaque state token, plus _clearDeployStateStoreForTests), mirroring workflow-step/state.ts + state-store.ts. State lives only in-process — never persisted to LMDB/Lance/DuckDB — preserving the k4 single-owner-of-storage rule and the S001 durability non-functional.
acceptanceChecks: src/mcp/deploy-step/state.ts exports DeployStepStage keyed off DeployPhase; src/mcp/deploy-step/state-store.ts holds a private run record keyed by the opaque state token.
state-store.ts exports _clearDeployStateStoreForTests() that resets the in-memory store, and imports no LMDB/Lance/DuckDB module.
Minting a run returns a token that round-trips to its record; an unknown/fabricated token resolves to no record; a record is discardable after next==='done'.
Files compile under strict mode; logging (if any) uses getLogger('deploy-<stage>')-style loggers, never console.log.

tests.name: src/mcp/deploy-step/__tests__/deploy-step-state.test.ts › minting a run returns an opaque token that round-trips to its record, an unknown/fabricated token resolves to no record, and _clearDeployStateStoreForTests() resets the private in-process store between runs
